package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"
)

// scenario for waitgroup_fanout_without_errgroup_on_error_path: WaitGroup-based goroutine fan-out that still carries explicit error-path coordination better suited to errgroup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: concurrency; severity: info.
func scenario228Positive(urls []string) ([]string, error) {
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var errs []error
	results := make([]string, 0, len(urls))

	for _, u := range urls {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(url string) {
			defer wg.Done()
			if url == "" {
				mu.Lock()
				errs = append(errs, errors.New("empty url"))
				mu.Unlock()
				return
			}
			mu.Lock()
			results = append(results, url+"_processed")
			mu.Unlock()
		}(u)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		return nil, errs[0]
	}
	return results, nil
}
